features.name: recent_heavy_rainfall_impact
features.description: Measures the combined effect of recent 3-day precipitation and current turbidity, capturing potential runoff events.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous severity measure of recent runoff, which is highly relevant for linear models assessing water quality impacts.

features.name: livestock_proximity_density_index
features.description: Ratio of combined livestock density to the distance of the nearest livestock facility, indicating proximity-weighted agricultural intensity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a smooth, normalized score representing agricultural pressure, allowing the SVM to easily weight proximity-based risks.

features.name: human_source_risk_score
features.description: Combines septic system density with the presence of wastewater infrastructure, stormwater outfalls, and human-specific bacteroides markers.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates multiple human-source indicators into a single weighted composite, reducing feature sparsity and improving linear separability.

features.name: environmental_survival_factor
features.description: Ratio of water temperature to recent solar radiation, representing environmental conditions conducive to microbial persistence.
features.expected_model_benefit: Offers a continuous environmental suitability metric, helping the model capture non-linear survival dynamics through a simple ratio.

features.name: flow_turbidity_interaction
features.description: Interaction between water flow and turbidity, highlighting conditions of active sediment transport.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the synergistic effect of flow and suspended solids, providing a strong linear projection for transport mechanisms.

features.name: developed_land_runoff_potential
features.description: Product of impervious cover and 5-day precipitation, estimating the potential for urban or developed surface runoff.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines land use and weather into a single continuous feature, allowing the model to directly weight developed runoff events.

features.name: agricultural_land_buffer_ratio
features.description: Ratio of agricultural land cover (pasture and crops) to forested and wetland areas within a 60-meter buffer.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized ratio of contrasting land uses, offering a stable, scale-invariant feature for linear margins.

features.name: water_quality_degradation_index
features.description: Composite index of water quality stress, penalizing low dissolved oxygen and deviations from neutral pH.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a continuous penalty score for poor water quality, simplifying the model's ability to identify degraded conditions.

features.name: chronic_wetness_indicator
features.description: Ratio of 30-day precipitation to estimated 30-day solar radiation, indicating prolonged wet and cloudy conditions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures long-term climatic context as a smooth ratio, helping the model adjust baseline expectations for wetness.

features.name: ruminant_contamination_severity
features.description: Scales the presence of ruminant-specific markers by the local density of cattle, sheep, and goats.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines a binary marker with continuous density, creating a severity-weighted feature that improves margin resolution.

features.name: overall_site_vulnerability_judgment
features.description: Semantic assessment of the site's overall vulnerability based on surrounding land use, infrastructure, and historical water quality parameters.
features.expected_model_benefit: Integrates complex, multi-faceted site characteristics into a single continuous score, providing a holistic risk assessment for the model.

features.name: seasonal_weather_risk_judgment
features.description: Semantic evaluation of the combined effect of seasonality, recent temperature trends, and precipitation patterns on environmental risk.
features.expected_model_benefit: Synthesizes temporal and meteorological variables into a unified risk metric, simplifying the model's interpretation of weather patterns.
